title: G8: Assembly chip on card faces (S)
description:
A small chip on each card face shows the assembly line (e.g. addi a0, zero, 5), for Course 2.
Acceptance:
- Given a card, a chip shows its assembly; it can be hidden by a lesson ui block.
- The chip never replaces the English text.
- Keyboard and screen reader read both.
